symptom: Fan Speed is Abnormal (Too High or Low, or Does Not Move)
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for it first. Monitoring code The fan speed can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 10007) Reference information Do all troubleshooting while the working mode is set to P mode.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting “Examine Engine Speed” of “Examine Engine Speed”. 2. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value? Stand- Item Measurement position, condition ard value 1000 to Engine at low idle 1100rp m Engine speed 1680 to Engine at high idle (swing lock ON) 1820rp m

branches.YES: • The engine speed is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The engine speed is defective. • Examine the engine. For details, see “Engine Does Not Rotate Smoothly” in S mode. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Examine if the alternator belt has wear or damage. 2. Is the alternator belt correct?

branches.YES: • The alternator belt is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The alternator belt is defective. • Replace the alternator belt. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the previous checks again. 2. Can you identify the cause by the reconfirmation?

branches.NO: • The fan clutch can be defective. • Replace the fan clutch. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine. 4. Does the fan operate correctly?

branches.NO: Go back to the first check item.
